title: AmCham hosts US envoy, military chief for security, economic talks
caption:
The US and South Korea are redefining their alliance by merging industrial power with military readiness. New talks suggest Korean shipyards and battery plants could soon become the primary maintenance hub for US forces in the region.

Source: Koreaherald - AmCham hosts US envoy, military chief for security, economic talks
